notes:
修复安装到 Program Files 时 Melon 离线红配无法写入：自动回退到本地缓存目录并播种 Cpp2IL/UnityDependencies，避免首次生成因 GitHub 超时失败；程序集生成失败时直接提示 Cpp2IL 下载错误，不再空等 180 秒。
Fix: when installed under Program Files, Melon offline redist falls back to a writable LocalAppData cache and seeds Cpp2IL/UnityDependencies so first-run generation is not stuck on GitHub timeouts; assembly generation now surfaces Cpp2IL download failures instead of waiting 180s silently.
